visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and glasses, wearing a navy blue shirt, records himself in a park. Beside him, a woman with dark hair tied back in a white shirt interacts with the camera. The background consists of a gazebo, green grass, and trees under bright daylight. (2) The man begins jogging along a curved park path bordered by a black fence. The camera follows him from the side and back as he runs past trees and open grass. He briefly turns to the camera to give a thumbs-up gesture while maintaining his pace. (3) The man and woman are inside a brightly lit supermarket. The man, wearing a yellow cross-body bag, picks up packages of raw chicken breast and salmon from a refrigerated display. The shelves are filled with various packaged produce and meats. (4) In a modern indoor kitchen, the man prepares food. He uses a metal knife to dice salmon on a wooden board and an electric hand mixer to beat eggs in a large metal bowl. He then adds shredded cabbage to the mixture and fries it in a black pan on a gas stove. (5) Late at night, the man sits in a dimly lit home office working on a laptop. He eats a prepared meal from a container. A white and gray cat jumps onto the desk, and he gently pets it while continuing his work.
